verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Skyvern serves a real llms.txt at skyvern.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a product summary for LLMs). An agent-oriented /llms page also lists capabilities, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: markdown versions of the docs (docs.md returned 404), evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-docs dump for agents, and independent corroboration of how useful the llms.txt is in practice.
